subject: Fiscal sprint: pipeline scrub & leadership pack actions
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Managers Group <managers@redwood.com>; laura.bennett@redwood.com; monica.patel@redwood.com; karthik.iyer@redwood.com; jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: finance@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Fiscal sprint: pipeline scrub & leadership pack actions

Team —

Quick note as we kick the August fiscal sprint: we need a targeted pipeline scrub this week with two concrete outputs for leadership:

1) Updated commit readiness (CSV) for all deals in Stages 4-7. Use the attached scrub_template_2027.csv. I only need the Owner, Commit status (Yes/No/Partial), Expected Close Date, Key Risks, and Primary Barrier.
2) Leader pack-ready one-pager for any >$250k commits with a short justification and any open legal/procurement blockers. Follow the attached leadership_pack_guidelines.md for format.

Please do the following by end of day Thursday (08/12):
- Owners: update scrub_template_2027.csv and mark high-risk deals with an *R* in the Key Risks column.
- Managers: review and escalate any deals that should be pulled into an executive sync.
- Finance: we need a quick forecast_delta_snapshot.xlsx (high-level delta vs. previous month) — @laura, can you run this?

I expect a short rollup note on Friday morning summarizing: total commit value, deals flagged (list), and any asks for credits/escrows or SLA exceptions. If you have a deal that is in flight with Acme Analytics, flag it in the tracker and loop in Paul — their procurement is now on a compressed timeline.

Attachments referenced: scrub_template_2027.csv, leadership_pack_guidelines.md

Thanks — keep this lean. I want minimal chase: fill the template, call out blockers, and we’ll triage in the 30-minute sync on Friday at 10:00 PT if needed.

—Michael
Michael Grant
VP, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>; Managers Group <managers@redwood.com>
Cc: finance@redwood.com; monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fiscal sprint: pipeline scrub & leadership pack actions

Michael —

Got it. I’ll pull the forecast delta and drop the snapshot into the shared drive by EOD Wednesday so teams have time to reconcile. Two quick clarifications before we roll:

- For "Commit status": do we want the conservative (legal-signed only) or pragmatic (verbal + finance MOP)? I recommend pragmatic for the initial scrub so we can capture upside; we can lock to signed in the final cut.
- For deals with external solutions partners (e.g., CloudOps), please add Partner Name in a new column so we can surface co-sell risk.

I’ll attach an updated_commit_tracker.csv with an extra Partner column — owners, please use that file as the canonical tracker.

Attachments: updated_commit_tracker.csv

Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, FP&A | Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>; laura.bennett@redwood.com; Managers Group <managers@redwood.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fiscal sprint: pipeline scrub & leadership pack actions

Thanks, Michael & Laura. A couple of operational notes from CS and Renewals:

- Renewal deals: we should include the last-touch NPS and any outstanding technical integrations as part of the "Primary Barrier" field — that helps leadership quickly assess enablement needs.
- Acme Analytics (Paul Darby): they're asking for a 60-day payment term and an SOC 2 report. I've linked the SOC 2 artifact in the Drive (see link below). Paul is copied here for visibility.
- I'll consolidate the >$250k one-pagers into a single packet and add a 1-line "Ask" (e.g., credit, exec intro, procurement priority) so leadership can action quickly.

Related links: https://docs.redwood.com/leadership-pack-guidelines (format)
Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/fiscal-sprint/Acme-SOC2 (SOC 2 artifact)

On owners: I’ve started filling the tracker for Renewals-heavy reps. If managers need me to triage specific accounts, DM and I’ll take them on.

—Monica
Monica Patel
Sr. Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
